description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
THE ROLE
At Everpure™, we empower innovators by simplifying how the world interacts with data. As a Sr. SAP CPI Developer on our expanding enterprise applications team, you will architect, deploy, and optimize high-impact SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) solutions that connect Everpure’s core operations across hybrid environments. Serving as a technical bridge between business strategy and modern SAP integration architecture, you will partner with enterprise architects, cross-functional business stakeholders, and engineering squads. Your work directly fuels operational scale, powering real-time data flows and generative AI workflows that keep our business-critical systems agile and resilient.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Architect Enterprise Integration Flows: Own the end-to-end design and deployment of resilient SAP CPI middleware connecting SAP and non-SAP platforms (via REST, SOAP, OData, IDOC, and SFTP) to accelerate data exchange for global business teams.
Scale Event-Driven & API Ecosystems: Partner with enterprise architects to establish integration governance, security standards, event-driven messaging (Advanced Event Mesh), and API management strategies that future-proof Everpure’s digital ecosystem.
Streamline Global B2B Connectivity: Lead the delivery of automated B2B and EDI integrations (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) using SAP Integration Suite, enabling seamless digital transactions with external trading partners.
Pioneer SAP Business AI & Automation: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering squads to embed generative AI, machine learning, and autonomous agent workflows across SAP S/4HANA and BTP, unlocking intelligent automation across the enterprise.
Elevate Engineering Excellence & Reliability: Guide onshore and offshore engineering partners through architectural reviews and agile delivery while driving proactive platform monitoring to safeguard mission-critical SLAs.
WHAT YOU BRING
Full-Lifecycle SAP Integration Mastery: Proven capability architecting, building, and supporting complex SAP CPI/BTP integration solutions from initial design through production optimization across distributed delivery teams.
Deep Technical & Scripting Fluency: Hands-on command of building integration flows using Groovy, Java, or Python alongside modern messaging protocols (REST, SOAP, IDOC, RFC, BAPI, OData, SFTP, and Solace/Event Mesh).
API Management & Event Mesh Expertise: Demonstrated ability to configure and govern event brokers, topics, queues, and API proxies/policies within SAP Event Mesh, Advanced Event Mesh, and SAP API Management.
B2B/EDI & Enterprise Security Execution: Practical expertise onboarding external trading partners via SAP Integration Suite (Trading Partner Management, Integration Advisor, AS2) while enforcing enterprise security frameworks (OAuth, SAML, SSL/TLS, XSUAA) across SAP BTP and Cloud Foundry.
Boomi Familiarity: Understanding of the Boomi integration platform is a plus.
We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, US office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.
#LI-ONSITE
This range is our good faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire, as of the date of this posting. Actual base pay within this range will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.
This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.
There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.
The annual base salary hiring range is:
$172,800—$211,200 USD
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:
Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.
And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.
ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:
Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:
We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
Join us and bring your best.
Bring your bold.
Pure and simple.
